  id("lane-kit").track("kit"),
  id("drums")

      symbols: { Kick: { note: 36, clip: "kick.wav" }, Snare: { note: 38, clip: "snare.wav" } },
    })
    .tap_outs({ Snare: "snare-fx" }),
  to([chain("MIX")]),
])

  id("snare-fx")

])
